original.statement: Crossplane v2 compositions can compose any resource (MRs, Deployments, third-party CRs), but Crossplane must be granted access to compose non-Crossplane resources.

decision.reason: [ev-2e05a423eff6] announces a new composition capability: an XR can compose any resource, including MRs, Kubernetes resources like a Deployment and third-party custom resources. That is not wire or protocol behaviour, so protocol-behavior is the wrong family. The excerpt also gives no earlier behaviour for the same configuration, so behavior-changed is unsupported. The evidence names no typed subject from the allowed families (field, flag, permission name) that a correct assertion could be built on.
